response.rationale: Systemic features (anemia, hypocomplementemia, proteinuria) and anti-Smith antibodies strongly favor SLE over cutaneous-limited SCLE or DLE. Skin findings and histology are compatible with lupus but not specific to a subtype.

rejected.why: Annular plaques and anti-SSA/Ro suggest SCLE, but systemic involvement and anti-Smith are more consistent with SLE.
Keratotic papules and interface dermatitis are nonspecific; DLE typically lacks systemic symptoms and has distinct scarring lesions, not described here.
